title: Sr. Brand Designer
text: Job Application for Sr. Brand Designer at C3.ai Apply Now Sr. Brand Designer at C3.ai (View all jobs) Redwood City C3.ai is a leading enterprise AI software provider for accelerating digital transformation. The comprehensive and proven C3 AI Suite uses a model-driven abstraction layer to enable organizations to develop, deploy, and operate enterprise scale AI applications 40x to 100x faster than alternative approaches. www.c3.ai C3.ai is seeking a Senior Brand Designer to play a key role in design, production and management of company brand deliverables across digital and print medias. This is a full time position and reports to the Creative Director within the corporate marketing department located in our Redwood City headquarters. In addition to being an excellent conceptual designer the candidate must have extensive experience designing and developing visual identity systems for corporate brands and be able to manage design and production for marketing initiatives. A strong work ethic, agility, and the ability to work under pressure are necessary for this role. An online portfolio of relevant work for review is required. Your Responsibilities: Lead visual design for brand identity and brand elements Lead visual design for a broad range of creative design and deliverables, including print collateral, branded environments, illustrative infographics, digital UI, wireframes, mockups, presentation slides, and branded templates Produce production ready artwork and manage production vendors related to marketing collateral and digital assets Provide design direction to creative team Curate creative processes for design and asset production Bring fresh direction and insight through design solutions while maintaining and reinforcing brand standards Collaborate and ideate creative solutions with corporate and product marketing teams Develop systems for organization and management of files to ensure operational effectiveness and efficiency Requirements: 8+ years of professional creative design experience with an agency or with an internal corporate marketing team. Bachelor's degree in a design-related discipline Ability to articulate and confidently present creative ideas to internal teams An online portfolio of relevant work demonstrating a deep understanding of design concepts including layout, composition, typography and color Ability to understand complicated concepts and illustrate them into clear and compelling visual narratives (infographics, animation, icons, charts, data visualization, etc…) Ability to design and format content and typography at an advanced level Experience developing brand systems and implementing brand elements across marketing assets and ability to evolve and extend brand systems and guidelines Expert knowledge of professional printing methods and ability to prepare clean, print-ready production files Understanding of current industry standards for optimizing user experience for website and mobile interfaces and experience designing wireframes and mockups for web and email Proven experience using Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, etc.) and presentation software Experience with video production, motion graphics, 3D design and animation skills are a plus Attributes: Ability to work simultaneously on multiple projects with short timelines, ensuring that deliverables are completed on time, on budget, and at the highest quality level. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and outstanding attention to detail. C3.ai provides a competitive compensation package and excellent benefits including: Competitive salary, generous stock options, 401K, medical, dental, and vision benefits. At the office, we offer a fully stocked kitchen with catered breakfast and lunch, table tennis and pool table, free membership at our on-site gym, Friday evening social hours with food, drink and music and a fun team of great people. C3.ai is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status. text: Job Application for Delivery Manager (Federal) at C3.ai Apply Now Delivery Manager (Federal) at C3.ai (View all jobs) Washington, D.C. C3.ai is a leading enterprise AI software provider for accelerating digital transformation. The comprehensive and proven C3 AI Suite uses a model-driven abstraction layer to enable organizations to develop, deploy, and operate enterprise scale AI applications 40x to 100x faster than alternative approaches. www.c3.ai The successful candidate is a highly skilled engagement manager preferably with experience in enterprise software and professional services. Technical skills in application development, predictive analytics and/or data integration are highly valued as well as domain experience in any of the following industries: manufacturing, supply chain, financial services, life sciences and high tech. The engagement manager will effectively work with executive customer stakeholders to define use cases and translate use cases into specifications, quantify and track business value, and work across business and technical teams to drive successful delivery of C3.ai products. This role requires US Citizenship or US Permanent Residence. Active Department of Defense (DoD) security clearance (Secret or higher) is preferred. Your Responsibilities: Qualified candidates have a minimum of 8-10 years of professional experience. The successful candidate will oversee the entire software implementation life cycle, including the following activities: Craft compelling use cases that drive business value, and translate use cases into requirements and specifications. Quantify and track value metrics that can be realized from C3.ai product implementations. Lead an engagement team to perform implementation activities in collaboration with C3.ai team members from Application Development, Data Integration, Data Science, Products, QA, and DevOps. Dive into technical details and lead activities to ensure successful delivery to our customers (e.g., functional scoping, application and data integration quality assurance, deliver trainings, issue debugging and resolution). Track, anticipate and address challenges before they become risks. Develop polished deliverables and other documentation to enable customer success. Effectively and proactively communicate with customers and build a trusted advisor relationship. Advise executive customer stakeholders on future use case roadmap and implementation plans aligned to C3.ai solutions. Travel to customer sites (50% average). Requirements: Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar field; MSc or MBA preferred Minimum of 8-10 years’ engagement management experience with enterprise SaaS solutions. Ability to successfully communicate and work with senior executive stakeholders. Effectively work across customer and internal teams to problem solve, define scope, write technical specifications, quantify and track success metrics, and manage against a plan. Demonstrated ability to navigate between the business and technical domains of a software implementation project, providing leadership in both. Excellent presentation, written, communication and interpersonal skills. Preferred Active Department of Defense (DoD) security clearance (Secret or higher) C3.ai provides a competitive compensation package and excellent benefits. Dans le cadre de cette croissance, nous recherchons un ingénieur SRE pour rejoindre notre équipe parisienne. Vos responsabilités : Assurez le temps de disponibilité des systèmes en respectant les niveaux de services établis. Maintenir une plateforme de surveillance et d’alerte pour tous les aspects critiques de l’infrastructure. Résoudre des problèmes complexes pour les services critiques et implanter de façon automatique les solutions aux problèmes récurrents. Être force de proposition sur la conception, l’architecture ainsi que les normes et méthodes pour supporter la plateforme. Création de scripts et automatisation des mises à jour et des mises à niveau système. Configurez une infrastructure critique ainsi que les outils dans le but d’améliorer le cycle de déploiement de la plateforme. Travailler de manière fonctionnelle avec les équipes de services et d'ingénierie. Expertise des systèmes d'exploitation Linux, des réseaux et des bases de données. Expérience avec Cassandra (ou une autre alternative NoSQL). Expertise dans les fournisseurs de cloud, tels qu'Amazon Web Services. Expérience des systèmes de gestion de la configuration tels que Chef ou Puppet. Expérience en Ruby ou Python; automatisation et surveillance des systèmes. Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en communication. The comprehensive and proven C3 AI Suite uses a model-driven abstraction layer to enable organizations to develop, deploy, and operate enterprise scale AI applications 40x to 100x faster than alternative approaches. www.c3.ai We are looking for tenured, well connected and motivated Sales Directors to lead C3.ai’s customer efforts in the assigned territories in the United States. Reporting to the Global GVP of Telecom and Media, this individual will be responsible for new client acquisition which includes prospecting, conveying ROI value proposals, deal progression, deal negotiation and deal closure. This individual should have a successful track record engaging telecom and media clients and closing transactions and exceeding quota. Building valuable go to market partnerships with network equipment providers and cloud infrastructure & microservices vendors is a plus. Candidates should be able to understand complex details across business and technology, business processes, and economic value, and communicate that complexity with simplicity. A successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment and demonstrate an ability to execute precisely and quickly. The candidate should possess a deep understanding of enterprise software and the telecom and media vertical. We are looking for sales directors in the following locations: Atlanta, New York City, Dallas, Denver, and Seattle. Your Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and manage the implementation of strategic sales plans. Manage efforts to research and identify customer prospects and targets. Build and maintain C3.ai’s company brand, establishing our position in the market. Collaborate with sales, products, and marketing teams to develop new product offerings within existing and new lines of business. Represent C3.ai by driving business development with company partners. Conduct market research and recommend product positioning and pricing strategy. Accountable for personal sales quotas based on corporate revenue goals. Personally engage in key account sales, business development, and ongoing customer success. Develop and actively maintain sales forecasts across assigned accounts and lines of business. Measure and report results of sales and plan execution. Identify areas for improvement and acts to implement positive change. Manage development and maintenance of referral-generation plans. Manage development and execution of external and internal sales communications plans. Requirements: 10+ years documented success in enterprise software sales or business technology products and services. Experience with and understanding of AI and Machine Learning is highly favorable. Experience creating data driven programs to drive company strategy. Exemplary written and oral communication skills. Excellent interpersonal, planning, and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience with data management and analysis. Bachelor’s degree required. Preferred Attributes: C3.ai is a culture of “doers”. Employees at all levels are willing to roll up their sleeves to get things done. The incoming leader is a team player who embodies those ideals and doesn’t hesitate to jump in and solve difficult problems. Ability to juggle and manage multiple priorities. Strong organizational and prioritization skills. Must be able to effectively meet deadlines and prioritize work assignments for efficiency. A high-energy individual who radiates positivity. This person inspires others through clarity and conviction of a shared vision. A humble individual who listens well and is coachable. A fixed focus on and commitment to accuracy, timeliness, and thoroughness. Deep understanding of and dedication to best-in-class employee service. Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to gather and analyze information and resolve difficulties quickly. Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively and work as part of a team. Ability to think critically and logically. Ability to work independently and in within a team. Ability to deliver results and meet expectations in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong moral compass and will understand the importance of ethics in business. This person is able to balance the lofty expectations of future company performance with the necessity to report information accurately and in accordance with company standards. C3.ai provides a competitive compensation package and excellent benefits. C3.ai is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status. text: Job Application for Senior Software Engineer, Front-End at C3.ai Apply Now Senior Software Engineer, Front-End at C3.ai (View all jobs) Redwood City C3.ai is a leading enterprise AI software provider for accelerating digital transformation. The comprehensive and proven C3 AI Suite uses a model-driven abstraction layer to enable organizations to develop, deploy, and operate enterprise scale AI applications 40x to 100x faster than alternative approaches. www.c3.ai C3.ai is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Front-End that will sit in our Redwood City, CA office. Responsibilities: Build modular, modular and highly scalable UI components using React, Redux, Bootstrap, D3, HighCharts, Jasmine and/or Webpack. Design, develop, and maintain performant and scalable full-stack applications. Build and improve visual tools for application development and data science that enable users to build an end-to-end AI application quickly. Work very closely with, and incorporate feedback from Product Management, User Interaction Designers, Front-End and Back-End Engineers. Lead cross-team technical design discussions on application architecture, UI components, UX, back-end and third-party integration, and testing. Rapidly fix bugs, solve problems, and proactively strive to improve our products and technologies. Manage individual project deliverables and mentor junior team members on industry coding standards and design techniques. Help build a team and cultivate innovation. Requirements: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields. 5+ years of professional software development experience with JavaScript, Java, or other object-oriented programming languages. Strong hands-on experience and understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and web application development. Experience working JavaScript frameworks such as React, Redux, Vue, Backbone, or Angular. Real passion for developing team-oriented solutions to complex engineering problems. Thrive in a dynamic, rapidly changing environment and value end-to-end ownership of projects. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate multi-functionally and improve scalability. Interest in committing to a fun, friendly, expansive, and intellectually stimulating environment. Preferred: Advanced degree in engineering, sciences or related field. Experience with Git or other version control software. Knowledge of Agile development methodology. Knowledge of distributed systems, test-driven development, SQL and NoSQL databases, and performance optimization tools. Experience in leading engineering teams and projects. Experience in building scalable web applications. C3.ai provides a competitive compensation package and excellent benefits including: Competitive salary, generous stock options, 401K, medical, dental, and vision benefits. title: Data Scientist (Federal)
text: Job Application for Data Scientist (Federal) at C3.ai Apply Now Data Scientist (Federal) at C3.ai (View all jobs) Washington, D.C. and Redwood City, California C3.ai is a leading enterprise AI software provider for accelerating digital transformation. The comprehensive and proven C3 AI Suite uses a model-driven abstraction layer to enable organizations to develop, deploy, and operate enterprise scale AI applications 40x to 100x faster than alternative approaches. www.c3.ai C3.ai is looking for a Data Scientist (Federal). In this capacity, you will participate in the definition of new analytics capabilities able to provide our customers with the information they need to make proper decisions to support our customers in operating IoT. In addition, you will help find the appropriate machine learning and specifically deep learning algorithms to answer these questions. Finally, you will be responsible for implementing this into the product and making it available to our customers. This role requires US Citizenship or US Permanent Residence. Active Department of Defense (DoD) security clearance (Secret or higher) is preferred. Your Responsibilities: Driving adoption of Deep Learning systems into next-generation of C3.ai products across Government, Aerospace, Healthcare, and other IoT applications. Designing and deploying deep learning algorithms on industrial IoT applications such as fraud detection and predictive maintenance. Collaborating with data and subject matter experts from C3.ai and its customer teams to seek, understand, validate, interpret, and correctly use new data elements. Requirements: US Citizenship or US Permanent Resident Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms & principles (regression analysis, time series, probabilistic models, supervised classification and unsupervised learning), and their application. Applied experience with Deep Learning algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks and LSTM. Familiarity with Deep Learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch, and strong experience in at least one of those. Strong background in numerical optimization. Experience with at least one of the following: Machine learning (deep learning, large-scale optimization, probabilistic inference, etc.), Natural language processing: sequence segmentation, knowledge extraction, multi-modal learning, etc.), Computer vision (large scale image classification, detection, segmentation, OCR, face recognition, etc.), and Reinforcement learning. Ability to drive a project and work both independently and in a team Smart, motivated, can do attitude, and seeks to make a difference Excellent verbal and written communication Preferred MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or equivalent fields. Specialization in machine learning preferred. text: Job Application for Data Scientist at C3.ai Apply Now Data Scientist at C3.ai (View all jobs) Paris, France C3.ai is a leading enterprise AI software provider for accelerating digital transformation. The comprehensive and proven C3 AI Suite uses a model-driven abstraction layer to enable organizations to develop, deploy, and operate enterprise scale AI applications 40x to 100x faster than alternative approaches. www.c3.ai Notre plateforme et les applications développées sur celle-ci sont majoritairement écrites en Java, JavaScript et Python. Nous développons et utilisons des technologies modernes (Spark, Cassandra, PostGres, Kafka, GraphX, Torch, etc.). Au cœur de cette architecture réside notre type system : une couche d’abstraction objet d’une grande expressivité qui permet aux développeurs et data scientists de décrire leurs données, d’utiliser des fonctionnalités existantes ou d’en définir de nouvelles sans se soucier de l’infrastructure ou des services sous-jacents. Cette technologie permet à nos utilisateurs de développer et de déployer en production des applications faisant appel à grande échelle en à peine quelques semaines. Le rôle L’équipe Data Science à C3.ai est responsable de la conception, de la mise en production et du suivi des solutions analytiques pour nos applications. Participer à la définition de nouvelles fonctionnalités analytiques capables de répondre aux problèmes de nos clients ou d’augmenter la valorisation des données disponibles Concevoir et valider en collaboration avec les clients une solution analytique en faisant éventuellement appel à des techniques de Machine Learning et de Data Mining Assurer l’implémentation de ces algorithmes dans la suite de produits C3.ai Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de C3.ai (Produits, Application, Plateforme, Services) pour construire les meilleures solutions possibles pour nos clients Diriger des projets au sein de C3.ai et avec nos clients, indépendamment et en équipe Votre profil : Les candidats sélectionnés auront une connaissance approfondie des techniques Machine Learning les plus courantes et de leurs applications. Ils comprendront également les limites de ces algorithmes et comment les modifier ou les dériver pour obtenir des résultats similaires à plus grande échelle. Diplôme d’ingénieur, Master ou Doctorat en informatique, mathématiques ou équivalent. En travaillant à C3.ai, les Data Scientistes doivent être prêts à se déplacer chez les clients selon les besoins Connaissance approfondie des techniques de Machine Learning (régression, séries temporelles, modèles probabilistes, apprentissage supervisé et non-supervisé, optimisation, deep learning) Très bonnes bases mathématiques (algèbre linéaire, probabilités et statistiques) Expertise en Python (un autre langage tel que Java, JavaScript ou Scala est un plus) Expérience avec des paradigmes Big Data (MapReduce, event processing, streaming) Excellent niveau de communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais Solides compétences organisationnelles, persévérance et attention aux détails Pédagogie et volonté d’expliquer vos modèles à des publics de tout niveau Force de proposition pour l’amélioration de services de Data Science dans notre plateforme Désir de résoudre des problèmes difficiles en équipe et de contribuer à développer un environnement inclusif, intellectuellement stimulant et fun (Glassdoor Best place to Work 2017) C3.ai is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. text: Job Application for Ingenieur DevOps at C3 Apply Now Ingenieur DevOps at C3 (View all jobs) Paris, France C3 répond à la forte croissance d'applications Big Data, IA et IoT à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour permettre la transformation numérique.La plate-forme C3 utilise les données en temps réel et l'analyse prédictive pour optimiser les processus métier, différencier les produits et services et créer de nouvelles sources de revenus.Grâce à l’innovant langage C3 et à une plate-forme ouverte et extensible, C3 est devenu le leader mondial des initiatives de transformation numérique. Dans le cadre de cette croissance, nous recherchons un ingénieur DevOps pour rejoindre notre équipe parisienne. Vos responsabilités : Développement collaboratif et tests de l’infrastructure pour répondre à la croissance rapide des systèmes. Améliorez la configuration automatisée du cloud, les déploiements, la surveillance, la gestion et la réponse aux incidents. Travaillez avec différentes équipes pour améliorer l'infrastructure C3 grâce à l'automatisation. Construire des outils internes pour démontrer la performance et l'efficacité opérationnelle. Collaborez avec d'autres équipes pour résoudre les problèmes liés à la configuration, au déploiement ou au débogage de l'application. Fournir de la documentation et une formation aux nouveaux membres du personnel et aux groupes connexes. Assurer l'administration du système, la configuration et le dépannage d'environnement Linux. Prendre en charge les escalades et les problèmes des clients européens Exigences : Configuration et exploitation de systèmes distribués. Scripting en Ruby / Python / Bash. Connaissance pratique des bases de données relationnelles et du language SQL. Expérience avec CloudFormation, Kubernetes et Docker. Expérience avec Puppet ou Chef. Rigueur dans la qualité du code, les tests automatisés et autres bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie. Analyse comparative des performances et outils de diagnostic. Expérience avec les plates-formes de surveillance et d'alerte. Expérience avec une infrastructure de diffusion en temps réel. Injection de données, traitement de queues, calculs. Connaissance approfondie de l'écosystème Amazon Web Services. Bac + 5, master, école d’ingénieur ou expérience professionnelle équivalente. Optionnel : Expérience avec Java / Scala. C3 fournit une rémunération compétitive et d'excellents avantages. title: Senior Data Scientist
text: Job Application for Senior Data Scientist at C3 AI Apply Now Senior Data Scientist at C3 AI (View all jobs) London, UK C3.ai, Inc. (NYSE:AI) is a leading provider of Enterprise AI software for accelerating digital transformation. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products: C3 AI® Suite, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating large-scale AI applications; C3 AI Applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS AI applications; C3 AI CRM, a suite of industry-specific CRM applications designed for AI and machine learning; and C3 AI Ex Machina, a no-code AI solution to apply data science to everyday business problems. The core of the C3 AI offering is an open, model-driven AI architecture that dramatically simplifies data science and application development. Learn more at: www.c3.ai As a member of the EMEA Data Science team, you will work with some of the largest companies on the planet helping them build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise applications on the C3 AI Suite ( c3.ai/customers/ ). You’ll work directly with data scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts in the definition of new analytics capabilities able to provide our customers with the information they need to make proper decisions and enable their digital transformation. You will help find the appropriate machine learning / data mining algorithms to answer those questions and implement those on the C3 AI Suite so they can run at scale. Qualified candidates will have an in-depth knowledge of most common machine learning techniques and their application. You will also understand the limitations of these algorithms and how to tweak them or derive from them to achieve similar results at large-scale. Your Responsibilities: Research, design, implement, and deploy Machine Learning algorithms for enterprise applications leveraging the C3 AI Suite. Assist and enable C3 AI customers to build their own applications on the C3 AI Suite. Lead a small technical team on a project, identify technical risks and mitigation strategies. Contribute to the design and implementation of new features of the C3 AI Suite. Contribute to making C3 AI a great place to work. Requirements: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Econometrics, Operational Research, or equivalent. 3+ years of professional experience applying ML, ideally in a customer facing role. Deep understanding of common ML techniques (regression and classification, timeseries analysis, supervised & unsupervised learning, and deep leaning). Strong mathematical background (linear algebra, calculus, statistics, optimization). Strong coding skills in Python (or similar object-oriented programming language). Ability to drive a project and work both independently and in a team. Smart, motivated, can do attitude, and seeks to make a difference. Curiosity and willingness to learn about our customers industries. Excellent verbal and written communication in English. Work will be conducted at our office and customer sites in the UK, with possible global travels. Preferred Knowledge of git and experience with JavaScript, Java or Scala is a plus. Experience with scalable ML (distributed systems, MapReduce, streaming). A portfolio of projects (GitHub, papers, etc.) is a plus. Good verbal and written communication skills in the local language. C3 AI provides a competitive compensation package and excellent benefits. C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status. text: Job Application for Chef de Projet at C3.ai Apply Now Chef de Projet at C3.ai (View all jobs) Paris, France C3.ai répond à une demande urgente et à croissance rapide d'applications Big Data, IA et IoT à l’échelle de l’entreprise pour permettre la Transformation Digitale. La plateforme C3.ai utilise le monitoring de performances en temps réel et l'analyse prédictive pour optimiser les processus métier, différencier les produits et services et créer de nouvelles sources de revenus. Grâce à l’innovant système du C3.ai Type System et à sa plateforme ouverte et extensible, C3.ai est devenu le leader mondial des initiatives de Transformation Digitale. Le(a) chef de projets pilote l’implémentation des applications C3.ai chez nos clients, leur mise en production et le suivi du projet. Ce rôle est critique pour le succès de nos clients et celui de C3. Le(a) chef de projets est le point de contact principal des clients et de nos équipes, durant toutes les phases du projet : planning, design, implémentation, et suivi après mise en production. Il(Elle) devra être capable de décrire clairement et précisément la situation du projet, gérer le calendrier de développement, identifier, communiquer et mitiger les risques, et établir une relation de confiance avec le client. Responsabilités clés: Le(a) chef de projet est un rôle de coordination des équipes C3.ai avec celles du client. En facilitant les discussions, éventuellement pour résoudre des conflits, il(elle) tiendra chaque membre responsable de ses engagements, et pilotera le cycle de développement complet de la solution au travers d’activités comme : Identification et collecte des besoins clients. Traduction des besoins en documentation fonctionnelle avec l’aide de l’équipe Produits. Mise au point et gestion d’un plan complet et détaillé du projet. Organisation de réunions de suivi avec les équipes concernées. Maîtrise de la portée du projet. Identification, anticipation et gestion des difficultés avant qu’elles ne deviennent des problèmes. Création et mise en commun des livrables et autres documentations nécessaires au client. Communication efficace et proactive avec le client pour construire une relation de confiance. Votre profil: 3-5 ans d’expérience dans la gestion de projets informatiques, idéalement des projets SaaS. Esprit d’équipe extraordinaire et capacité à travailler avec des équipes diverses et multiculturelles, pour définir la portée, les objectifs, le plan et les livrables du projet. Capacité à mettre au point et gérer un plan de projet complexe et détaillé. Organisation et minutie pour la définition et le suivi des attentes du projet, des dépendances, des dates clés, les livrables et le budget pour garantir leur conformité avec les exigences du client. Adepte des méthodes de développement agile, et compétences Scrum. Expérience avec des outils de management de projet, comme JIRA. Capacité à jongler entre des aspects techniques et business, et devenir un moteur sur chacun. License (Bac+3) ; Diplôme d’ingénieur, Master en informatique ou MBA apprécié. Excellent niveau de communication orale et écrite en anglais (niveau C1 en Français). title: Manager, Solution Engineering
text: Job Application for Manager, Solution Engineering at C3 AI Apply Now Manager, Solution Engineering at C3 AI (View all jobs) Redwood City, CA C3.ai, Inc. (NYSE:AI) is a leading provider of Enterprise AI software for accelerating digital transformation. The proven C3 AI Platform provides comprehensive services to build enterprise-scale AI applications more efficiently and cost-effectively than alternative approaches. The core of the C3 AI offering is an open, data-driven AI architecture that dramatically simplifies data science and application development. Learn more at: www.c3.ai C3 AI is looking for a manager to provide leadership and direction to the Solution Engineering team of bright and ambitious self-starters like yourself. You will be part of a fast-moving organization with highly motivated software engineers who tackle challenging and impactful problems. This management position is highly visible, will require frequent communication and interactions with the senior leadership team, and will require a driven individual to take on the responsibilities to develop and shape the Customer Solutions organization and strategic team goals. Responsibilities: Be passionate about driving and leading your team to success and helping them excel. Grow the Solutions Engineering team by hiring and developing engineers within the existing team. text: Job Application for Product Marketing (Manager/ Sr. Manager/ Lead), Platform Products at C3 AI Apply Now Product Marketing (Manager/ Sr. Manager/ Lead), Platform Products at C3 AI (View all jobs) Redwood City, California C3.ai, Inc. (NYSE:AI) is a leading provider of Enterprise AI software for accelerating digital transformation. The proven C3 AI Platform provides comprehensive services to build enterprise-scale AI applications more efficiently and cost-effectively than alternative approaches. The core of the C3 AI offering is an open, data-driven AI architecture that dramatically simplifies data science and application development. Learn more at: www.c3.ai Product Marketing Managers are responsible for thinking through all product positioning, marketing, outbound, and commercial aspects of C3 AI's products. Product Marketing Managers interact with C3 AI’s existing and prospective customers to bring the voice of our customers to our product roadmap; help drive product strategy; develop product messaging and positioning (including website, blog posts, case studies, other internal and external collateral); enable sales with a robust portfolio of content; develop messages to support our GTM; help craft product packaging and pricing; engage with analysts, and work with marketing to run effective customer engagement and awareness campaigns. As a Platform Product Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for the C3 AI Platform product. This is a technical product that supports the full AI application life cycle – from the development, deployment, and operations of large-scale enterprise AI applications. The C3 AI Platform provides no-code, low-code, and deep-code development tools for application developers, data scientists, data engineers, DevSecOps, and IT Ops teams. You will live the customer journey of these teams, help us define future innovation, identify and execute on market opportunities, and build stories to help us engage current and future customers for long-term success, all while differentiating us from the competition. Your impact will touch all parts of the company and help us fuel our growth across industries and buyers. Our ideal candidate is a creative thinker with analytic and problem-solving capabilities, a compelling storyteller, and has a technical background with an understanding of some or all of the underlying capabilities (e.g., data integration, persistence/virtualization, processing, AI/ML infrastructure, workflows, app logic, and UI frameworks) required to power enterprise AI applications. You are familiar with modern cloud software services, and containerization frameworks, and are up to date with modern open-source projects that pertain to large-scale compute AI/ML, or applications. You can transform complex needs and solutions into simple differentiated messages, while also having a passion for people demonstrated by engaging cross-functionally to deliver sophisticated products and solutions. Responsibilities: Develop a deep understanding of customer requirements and the C3 AI Platform capabilities; partner with Product Managers to define market opportunities and influence roadmap priorities. Create and execute go-to-market plans for product launches and new releases. Develop compelling and easy-to-understand product content for Sales and Pre-sales including sales training on products, positioning, competitive analyses, FAQs, cheat sheets, and more. Develop compelling external product content including data sheets and product case studies, website content, blogs, webinars, solution guides, product launches, and more. Develop and track key business metrics for your products, evaluating the state of your business. Support Sales and Pre-sales throughout the sales cycle to inspire, motivate, and ultimately win customer business. Collaborate with the marketing organization to enable appropriate product positioning and materials on the C3 AI website; and run appropriate campaigns to create product awareness. Present with authority at industry conferences, panels, and customer and internal events. text: Job Application for Lead Data Scientist – Generative AI at C3 AI Apply Now Lead Data Scientist – Generative AI at C3 AI (View all jobs) Redwood City, CA C3.ai, Inc. (NYSE:AI) is a leading provider of Enterprise AI software for accelerating digital transformation. The proven C3 AI Platform provides comprehensive services to build enterprise-scale AI applications more efficiently and cost-effectively than alternative approaches. The core of the C3 AI offering is an open, data-driven AI architecture that dramatically simplifies data science and application development. Learn more at: C3 AI As a member of the C3 AI Data Science team, you will work with some of the largest companies on the planet helping them build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise applications on the C3 AI Platform ( c3.ai/customers/ ). You will work directly with researchers, data scientists, software engineers, and subject matter experts in the definition of new generative AI capabilities able to provide our customers with the information they need to make proper decisions and enable their digital transformation. Qualified candidates will have an in-depth knowledge of the most common Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval Methods, know how to train and fine-tune LLMs, and design and implement LLM-powered agents and tools at scale. Responsibilities: Design and deploy Generative AI solutions, such as information retrieval and coding assistance, for industrial customers. Collaborate with Generative AI subject matter experts from C3 AI, its customer teams, and academia to identify, design, and implement innovative and differentiated solutions using cutting-edge research on LLMs and Generative AI. Drive the adoption and scalability of Generative AI offerings within C3 AI products. Qualifications: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or equivalent fields. Applied Machine Learning experience (regression and classification, supervised, and unsupervised learning). Strong mathematical background (linear algebra, calculus, probability, and statistics). Proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming. Strong experience working with machine learning and natural language processing techniques and tools. Strong experience using Generative AI models, with a good understanding of deep learning model classes such as GPT, VAE, and GANs, as well as their hyperparameters. Strong experience with retrieval methods e.g. using embeddings. Strong experience using key Python packages for data wrangling, machine learning and deep learning such as pandas, sklearn, TensorFlow, torch, transformers, LangChain, etc. Experience in Prompt Engineering and few-shot techniques to enhance LLM's performance on specific tasks. Experience with training and fine-tuning deep learning models, especially LLMs, and how to tune hyperparameters to ensure task generalization. Ability to drive a project and work both independently and within a cross-functional team. Smart, motivated, can-do attitude, innovative and seeks to make a difference in a fast-paced environment. Excellent verbal and written communication, able to articulate complex concepts with a non-technical audience. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with embedding model training and retrieval method evaluation approaches. Experience with LLM architectures, adapters, Mixture of Experts (MoEs) pretraining and fine-tuning techniques. Experience with design, deployment, and evaluation of LLM-powered agents and tools and orchestration approaches. Experience with reinforcement learning approaches in the context of fine-tuning LLM outputs. Experience with time series analysis and multivariate time series modeling. C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan. California Pay Range $180,000 — $245,000 USD C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. (NYSE:AI) is a leading provider of Enterprise AI software for accelerating digital transformation. The proven C3 AI Platform provides comprehensive services to build enterprise-scale AI applications more efficiently and cost-effectively than alternative approaches. The core of the C3 AI offering is an open, data-driven AI architecture that dramatically simplifies data science and application development. Learn more at: www.c3.ai C3 AI has an opening for a Vice President, Corporate Controller to work in our Redwood City, CA office. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer and will be responsible for capturing, defining, and ensuring the accuracy of non-GAAP financial metrics. They will work closely with our external and internal auditors, and other members of the organization to complete our monthly and quarterly reporting on a timely basis. This role instills a culture of strong internal controls across the company and is responsible for compliance with our technical accounting standards, GL, and sub-modules for efficient operations and global revenue. Responsibilities: Guide financial decisions by establishing, monitoring, and enforcing policies and procedures. Protect assets by establishing, monitoring, and enforcing internal controls. Monitor and confirm financial condition by conducting audits and providing information to external auditors. Accountable for ensuring consistent compliance of corporate accounting principles and procedures in full compliance with US GAAP and SEC reporting standards. Experience with and own direct responsibility for financial systems, including NetSuite, Coupa, Stock Administration, Workiva, and FloQast. Drive processes to optimize and automate accounting operations to drive efficient monthly/quarterly close cycles and improve accuracy and efficiency. Partner effectively with other finance team members and non-accounting functions to drive improved controls and process enhancements. Demonstrate strong business judgment applied to routine and complex financial and accounting issues. DRI and owner of and will lead the monthly close process and is responsible for achieving our target for days to close. Set the standards as a leader and coach for increased levels of employee job satisfaction and employee engagement through the development and mentoring of the accounting team. Qualifications: Successful candidate will have 10+ years’ experience as Corporate Controller who has worked in both public and private company environments. Bachelor’s degree in accounting or equivalent and CPA license is required; MBA preferred. Ability to both grow in the role and grow with the company, demonstrating leadership capabilities and upward progression. Proven international experience working with overseas financial operations (payroll, consolidation, compliance). Proven success managing complex global business entities, and proven ability to handle financial accounting and reporting duties. Extensive experience with software revenue recognition and stock equity expensing and administration. Experience in FP&A and forecasting tools, in particular ability to partner and provide necessary information to FP&A partners for appropriate forecasting. Experienced at collaborating with business leaders and working across functional areas to articulate financial priorities and influence decisions to improve financial results. Proficient in the use of various software applications, such as NetSuite, Concur, and Microsoft Excel. Excellent technical, computing, and analytical skills, accompanied by proficiency with various software applications. Willingness to do whatever it takes for the department to run effectively. Excellent communication skills. Big Four public accounting experience, preferred. C3 AI provides excellent benefits and a competitive compensation package, which include: Generous equity plan. Salary range: $240,000 - $330,000 USD. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship. C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status. text: Job Application for AI Solution Manager at C3 AI Apply Now AI Solution Manager at C3 AI (View all jobs) London, UK C3.ai, Inc. AI Solution Managers work with our customers to identify and quantify high-impact business opportunities and scope them into problems that can be solved by C3 AI's platform, then drive the delivery of solutions with compelling business value. AI Solution Managers have a detailed understanding of C3 AI’s competitive position in the Operations Research, Logistics, Network Analysis solutions markets and deep knowledge of the related problems AI/ML and Optimization can solve. Recent examples of successful engagements include production schedule optimization, supply network visibility, supply chain process mining, and assembly line predictive maintenance. These are impactful projects with high levels of internal and external visibility. Responsibilities: Lead high-performing C3 AI teams including data scientists, solutions engineers, application engineers, and product managers in the delivery of quick turnaround, production-ready AI/ML applications. Qualifications: Qualified candidates will combine an advanced technical degree with domain expertise in diverse supply chain environments. Knowledge of existing AI/ML/Big Data use cases in the industry and the ability to lead use case development with customers. Experience with Network Analysis, Sequencing Problems, Linear Programming, Queuing, Inventory Control, Replacement Problems. Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, and experience in delivering effective presentations to senior executives – decision-makers, IT executives, and SMEs. Technical, polished, driven, goal-oriented, and proven record of delivery. Ability to learn quickly with excellent analytical problem-solving skills. Ability to lead projects and work collaboratively across diverse global distributed teams. Have directly led or supported the sales process. Preferred Qualifications: Master of Science in Data Science, Operations Research, Engineering, Statistics, Applied Math or similar field. Successful candidates will get the opportunity to work on high-value technologies at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, data infrastructure, and machine learning. You will design, develop, and maintain various features in a highly scalable and extensible AI/ML platform for large-scale applications, involving data science, distributed systems, and multi-cloud strategy. You will be given opportunities to take ownership of components, collaborate to drive technical direction, and work on interesting, impactful projects. Join us in building the next-generation AI/ML platform at petabyte level scale that powers some of the world’s largest companies in Energy, Financial Services, Utilities, Health Care, Aerospace, Defense, etc. Accelerate your career in the leading enterprise AI company that is in a hyper-growth trajectory. Responsibilities: Design and develop infrastructure and services to enable data pipelines for petabyte level scale and more. Design and develop abstractions over datastores such as Cassandra, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, etc. Design and develop file system abstractions over AWS S3, Azure Blobs, HDFS, etc. Design and develop connectors to various external data stores. Design and develop distributed system components for stream processing, queueing, batch processing, analytics engines, etc. Develop and maintain industry-leading, high-performance APIs for AL/ML applications. Develop and maintain features for distributed computations over large-scale data for ML workflows. Design and develop ML-specific data-systems such as feature stores and behavioral frameworks such as recommendation engines. Design and develop integrations with distributed computing technologies such as Apache Spark, Ray, etc. for data exploration and ML workload orchestration. Design and develop integrations with data analysis libraries such as Pandas, Koalas, etc. Develop and production AI/ML models for failure prediction, data schema inferencing, etc. Work on frameworks for performance, scalability, and reliability tracking over different components of a highly extensible AI/ML platform. Work with architects, product managers, and software engineers across teams in a highly collaborative environment. Participate and provide insights in technical discussions. Write clean code following a test-driven methodology. Deliver commitments promptly following agile software development methodology. Qualifications: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields. Strong understanding of Computer Science fundamentals. High proficiency in coding with Java, C++, C#, or some other compiled language. Python would also be acceptable. Strong competency in object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns. Experience with version control systems such as Git. Experience with large-scale distributed systems. Experience with any public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP). Some familiarity with distributed computing technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka). Familiarity with managed versions of these technologies on public cloud platforms is also acceptable. Familiarity with technologies in the modern data science/analysis and engineering ecosystem (e.g., Pandas, Koalas). Good verbal and written technical communication ability to facilitate collaboration. Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and value end-to-end ownership of components. Intellectually curious and open to challenges. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced degree in engineering, sciences, or related field. Experience with Agile development methodology. Experience developing and working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs. Experience building scalable and reliable data pipelines. Experience with integration of data from multiple sources. Experience working with analytics and/or data processing engines. Experience developing distributed computation over large-scale data. Experience working with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka). Experience with data science/analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, Koalas). Experience with task schedulers in distributed computing (e.g., Spark, Ray, Dask). Familiarity with machine learning workload orchestration in a distributed computing environment. Familiarity with workflow execution and/or optimization using DAGs, ideally for machine learning use-cases. Conceptual understanding of orchestration and resource provisioning systems (Kubernetes). You will maintain the domain-specific language (DSL) and the core Java implementation for the Type System. You will build the language software development toolkits (SDKs) that allow internal and external developers to access the C3 Type System from all supported languages (Java, JavaScript, and Python). Understanding of software development principles and design patterns. Understanding of software development lifecycle, tools, and standard methodologies. Experience with static code analysis and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) libraries for Java, JavaScript, and Python. Experience with inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms such as socket (over the network), shared memory, memory-mapped file, and named pipe. Experience using tools and frameworks such as ANTLR, Rhino, JEP (Java Embedded Python), and py4j. Experience with popular package managers for Python (pip, conda, mamba) and JavaScript (npm). You will work closely with our external auditors, and other members of the organization to complete our SOX program on a timely basis. This role plays a key role in driving a control conscious, SOX compliant organization. In this role, you will have the opportunity to participate in the transformation of the SOX team and play a critical role in the development and enhancement of the SOX program. Given our on-site working environment, candidates must be able to work from our office in Redwood City, California Responsibilities: Contribute to the overarching SOX plan by assisting with the SOX risk assessment, scoping and controls rationalization & optimization process (including updating controls language and flowcharts as necessary). Responsible for identifying and assisting in documenting existing controls, implementing, and documenting new internal controls, and establishing an internal monitoring function to audit the company’s compliance with internal controls. Prepare clear and concise testing documentation in accordance with team methodologies and ensure the work performed supports conclusions drawn. Identify mitigating controls and procedures to effectively mitigate deficiencies. Assist management with remediation plan development, execution, tracking and support for control owners. Reduce redundant testing, anticipate future team needs, and continue the adoption of newer audit techniques to streamline the process. Lead end to end walkthroughs to identify risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities. Work with the external auditors to manage their testing cycles and expectations. Serve as a contact for the external auditors and will assist in coordinating SOX efforts between the SOX department, SOX stakeholders and external audit. Make improvement recommendations of the control environment and assist with pre-implementation, control identification, and deficiency evaluation. Assist the IT SOX Team with IPEs (information provided by the client) testing, review of SOC (service organization controls) SaaS applications and ITAC controls. Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in Internal Controls, External and/or Internal Audit. Big 4 experience is a plus. CPA, CIA or other professional certifications in a related field are a plus. Experience with tech companies that have SaaS models (subscriptions, professional services, etc.) is a plus. Considerable knowledge and a proven track record in applying internal controls and accounting principles and practices, specifically as it relates to SOX risk assessment, process documentation and flowcharting, control design assessment, test plan design, sampling techniques, testing of operational effectiveness and documenting of deficiencies. Strong understanding of the COSO internal controls framework. Foundational knowledge and understanding of IT General Controls, application controls and key reports testing. Ability to operate when requirements are not clear and to identify solutions to problems. Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective communicator, ability to build relations & manage expectations. Working knowledge of SOX best practices and emerging trends. Ability to adapt to a fast paced continually changing business and work environment while managing multiple priorities. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future company sponsorship.
